title: 第1章 不成器的败家子第2章 打猎加点
slug: 打猎娶妻加点我无敌了
lines: 林夜是被说话声吵醒的。
声音从堂屋传来，他侧耳听了会，是父母在说话。
“去年老吴家的一亩地卖了五两，咱家地比他家肥，多少也能卖个六两。”
父亲林大河的声音闷闷的，带着点犹豫。
母亲常氏一向大嗓门，这会压低了，还是听得清清楚楚。
“六两？你做梦呢，也不看看啥年景，能有个四两都不错了，亏死个人！”
林大河长叹一声：“不卖又有什么办法？二郎的药不能断，家里粮食撑不了多久，这个冬天可没法过。”
林夜默然，盯着灰扑扑的房梁。
他穿越过来已经好几天了。
原主也叫林夜，十七八岁，家住上白村。
在家排行老二，上面有个嫁出去的姐姐，下头还一个不满五岁的妹妹。
他先天不足，打小就是个病秧子，还是家里唯一的男丁，爹娘娇惯，养成了游手好闲的毛病。
早些时候被几个狐朋狗友撺掇去了赌坊，输多赢少，给家底都败得七七八八。
今年年景不好，家里刚交完税，本来也没剩下多少口粮。
原主还偷了家里的粮食换了些钱去赌坊，又输了个精光。
回来的路上被人敲了闷棍，丢进沟里，被人抬回来的时候只剩半口气。
之后不出意外的断气了，身体也换了个芯。
废物败家子。
林夜在心里暗骂一声，从床上坐起身。
后脑和后背还有些疼，但已经可以简单活动。
心中默念系统，一块淡蓝色的光幕就出现在眼前。
【林夜】
力量：2
体质：2
敏捷：2
自由属性点：0
天赋：暂无
技能：箭术（初窥门径，熟练度010）
【妻子】
暂无。
这是他前世喜欢玩的一款打猎游戏的面板，跟着他一起穿越而来。
击杀猎物，就能获得属性点，还有概率获取天赋。
和妻子零距离互动，也有概率直接提升属性和天赋能力。
妻子名额无限制，魅力值越高，好感度越高，提升的也就越多。
而通过不断练习技能，还能提升技能熟练度，让自己获得更强的战斗技巧。
原主身体本来就差，还受了伤，距离正常成年男性五点的属性相差甚远。
现在他唯一的技能是箭术，这可不是原主那个不学无术的家伙会的，而是金手指自带的。

;;
Lin Ye was woken up by the sound of voices.
The sound came from the main room, and he listened carefully for a while. It was his parents talking.
"Last year, one acre of land from Lao Wu's family was sold for five taels. Our land is fatter than his family's, so we can sell it for six taels."
Father Lin Dahe's voice was muffled and a little hesitant.
My mother, Mrs. Chang, has always had a loud voice. She lowered her voice now, but she could still be heard clearly.
"Six taels? You're dreaming. No matter what the circumstances, it's good to have four taels. It's a shame!"
Lin Dahe sighed: "What can we do if we don't sell it? Erlang's medicine can't be stopped, and the family's food won't last long. We won't be able to survive this winter."
Lin Ye was silent, staring at the dusty beams.
It has been several days since he traveled through time.
The original owner was also named Lin Ye, he was seventeen or eighteen years old and lived in Shangbai Village.
She is the second eldest child in the family. She has a married sister above her and a younger sister who is under five years old.
He was born with deficiencies and had been sick since he was a child. He was the only male in the family. His parents pampered him and he developed a habit of idleness.
Earlier, I was lured to a gambling house by some bad friends. I lost more than I won and my family was completely ruined.
This year has been a bad year. The family has just paid taxes and doesn’t have much food left.
The original owner also stole food from the family in exchange for some money and went to a gambling house, where he lost everything again.
On the way back, he was beaten with a sap and thrown into a ditch. When he was carried back, he was only half-breathed.
Then, as expected, he died, and his body also changed its core.
Waste and prodigal son.
Lin Ye cursed secretly in his mind and sat up from the bed.
There is still some pain in the back of my head and back, but I can now move around easily.
Thinking about the system silently in your mind, a light blue light curtain appeared in front of you.
【Lin Ye】
Strength: 2
Constitution: 2
Agility: 2
Free attribute points: 0
Talent: None yet
Skill: Archery (first glimpse, proficiency 010)
【Wife】
None yet.
This is the panel of a hunting game he liked to play in his previous life, and it traveled through time with him.
By killing prey, you can obtain attribute points and have a chance to obtain talents.
There is also a chance of directly improving attributes and talents by interacting with your wife at close range.
There is no limit to the number of wives. The higher the charm value, the higher the favorability, and the more you will improve.
By continuously practicing skills, you can also improve your skill proficiency and gain stronger combat skills.
The original owner was already in poor health and was injured. He was far from the five attributes of a normal adult male.
Now his only skill is archery. This is not what the original owner, the uneducated guy, knows, but what Goldfinger comes with.
